steps.name: Live preview card
steps.goal: Wait for the web project preview card. Only inspect it and do not tap anything.
steps.done: The card names the Expo app, says the preview is live, and offers an open action.

steps.name: Expired Expo Go link
steps.goal: Find the card for 'My old app'. Only inspect it and do not tap anything. A 'Link expired' message on this card is the expected result of this test, not an error.
steps.done: The 'My old app' card says the Expo Go link expired and shows a 'Restart preview' button.
expect: The Expo Go link expired. Restart the preview to get a new one.

steps.name: Expo Go card, Expo signed in
steps.goal: Find the card for 'My todo app'. Only inspect it and do not tap anything.
steps.done: The todo app card shows three short steps: get Expo Go, sign in as the Expo account with a tick, and open in Expo Go.

steps.name: Expo not signed in
steps.goal: Find the card for 'My connect app'. Only inspect it and do not tap anything.
steps.done: The 'My connect app' card shows the Expo mark, one line 'Preview on your iPhone', and two buttons: 'Create free account' and 'I have one'.
forbid: Create your Expo account in the Computer window
Sign in to Expo in the Computer window

steps.name: Stopped preview
steps.goal: Find the card for 'My sleeping app', the first card. Tap its 'Restart preview' button, the first 'Restart preview' on the screen, directly below 'The development server is not running. This happens when the Computer sleeps.' 'Stopped' and 'Link expired' on these test cards are expected results of this test, not errors.
steps.done: The stopped card says the agent was asked to restart the preview.
expect: The development server is not running. This happens when the Computer sleeps.
Asked the agent to restart it

steps.name: Create free account
steps.goal: On the 'My connect app' card, tap 'Create free account' once. Do not tap 'Open in Expo Go' on any card.
steps.done: A sheet titled 'Sign up for Expo' is open. Under the title it names the site expo.dev with a lock, and at the bottom it offers 'Open the full Computer view'. This test has no Computer, so the sheet body says it is opening expo.dev; that is expected.

steps.name: Close the Expo sheet
steps.goal: In the 'Sign up for Expo' sheet, tap the close button (the X, labelled 'Cancel and close') at the top right once.
steps.done: The sheet is closed. The 'My connect app' card says the Expo sign-in was cancelled and offers 'Create free account' and 'I have one' again.
